mapper.insert: insert into article_vector_index ( article_key, concept_id, model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions, index_version, content_hash, embedding, updated_at ) values ( #{record.articleKey}, #{record.conceptId}, #{record.modelProfileId}, #{record.embeddingDimensions}, #{record.indexVersion}, #{record.contentHash}, cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName}), #{record.updatedAt} ) on conflict (article_key) do update set concept_id = excluded.concept_id, model_profile_id = excluded.model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions = excluded.embedding_dimensions, index_version = excluded.index_version, content_hash = excluded.content_hash, embedding = excluded.embedding, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: select article_key, concept_id, model_profile_id, embedding_dimensions, index_version, content_hash, embedding::text as embedding, updated_at from article_vector_index where article_key = #{articleKey}
mapper.update: alter table article_vector_index alter column embedding type ${vectorTypeName}(${targetDimensions})
create index if not exists ${indexName} on article_vector_index using hnsw (embedding ${opClass})
create index if not exists ${indexName} on article_vector_index using ivfflat (embedding ${opClass}) with (lists = 100)
mapper.select: select updated_at from article_vector_index order by updated_at desc limit 1
select distinct profile.model_name from article_vector_index vector_index join llm_model_profiles profile on profile.id = vector_index.model_profile_id order by profile.model_name asc

select format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = current_schema() and c.relname = 'article_vector_index' and a.attname = 'embedding' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped

select am.amname from pg_index idx join pg_class index_rel on index_rel.oid = idx.indexrelid join pg_class table_rel on table_rel.oid = idx.indrelid join pg_namespace namespace_rel on namespace_rel.oid = table_rel.relnamespace join pg_am am on am.oid = index_rel.relam join pg_attribute attr on attr.attrelid = table_rel.oid where namespace_rel.nspname = current_schema() and table_rel.relname = 'article_vector_index' and attr.attname = 'embedding' and attr.attnum = any(idx.indkey) order by index_rel.relname asc limit 1

select a.source_id, a.article_key, a.concept_id, a.title, a.content, a.metadata_json::text as metadata_json, a.review_status, a.source_paths, 1 - (v.embedding ${distanceOperator} cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName})) as score from article_vector_index v join articles a on a.article_key = v.article_key order by v.embedding ${distanceOperator} cast(#{vectorLiteral} as ${vectorTypeName}), a.compiled_at desc limit #{limit}
select amname from pg_am where amname in ('hnsw','ivfflat') order by case amname when 'hnsw' then 0 else 1 end limit 1
select opcnamespace::regnamespace || '.vector_cosine_ops' from pg_opclass where opcname = 'vector_cosine_ops' order by oid asc limit 1
